intent: Technical Brief: ASUS ROG Strix Scar System State Baseline
detected_fault: Overheating while idle, with fans failing to come on and temperatures exceeding 80C
suggested_solution: Perform a thorough system cleaning and dust removal to ensure proper airflow.
Update Armoury Crate and ASUS System Analysis drivers to the latest versions.
Monitor system temperatures closely during idle periods to identify potential issues early on.
Consider running stress tests, such as Prime95 or OCCT, to further diagnose the issue.
